instruction: A candid medium shot of a residential outdoor scene during the day. On the right side of the frame, the woman in the black patterned blouse (R1) stands facing left, handing a set of keys to her client. On the left, the man in the dark gray puffer jacket (R2) stands in a back-three-quarters view, reaching out to receive the keys. They shake hands simultaneously in front of a white-sided house with a pink "SOLD" sign in the background. Natural daylight softly illuminates the scene, creating gentle shadows and a bright atmosphere with a shallow depth of field.
